@deskSetupConfirmPassword.description: Field label and screen reader label on the password step of creating or restoring a wallet: type the password again.

@deskSetupPasswordShort.description: Error under the password field when the new password is shorter than 8 characters.

@deskSetupPasswordsDiffer.description: Error under the confirm field when the two passwords are not the same.

@deskSetupBack.description: Button in the foot of the first-run and setup screens: one step back.

@deskSetupNewWalletAdded.description: Notice on the Unlock screen after a new wallet was created; the wallet is selected below it.

@deskSetupCapsLock.description: Warning under a password field while Caps Lock is on. Caps Lock is the key's name as printed on keyboards.

@deskSetupStepSem.description: Screen reader announcement of the step a progress list is on, e.g. 'Step 2 of 4: Scanning the chain'.

@deskSetupTryAgain.description: Button after a step of creating or restoring a wallet failed: run it again.

@deskSetupNotSaved.description: Toast title when the setup's settings could not be saved; the reason follows.

@deskSetupStepPrefs.description: Setup step and its title: app preferences (the language). Also a section head on the setup's last step. Short: it is in the step list of a narrow side panel.

@deskSetupStepNode.description: Setup step in the side panel's step list (choose the Epic node), and a section head on the last step. One word.

@deskSetupStepEpicbox.description: Setup step in the side panel's step list (the Epicbox server for receiving), and a section head on the last step. Epicbox is a product name: keep it.

@deskSetupStepReview.description: Setup's last step in the side panel's step list: check everything, then save. One word.

deskSetupAgain: Running setup again. Nothing changes until Save on the last step.

@deskSetupAgain.description: Lead under each step's title when setup is opened again from Settings. 'Save' is the button on the last step (deskSetupSave).

@deskSetupPrefsLead.description: Lead under the title of the setup's Preferences step, which has the language picker.

@deskSetupNodeTitle.description: Title of the setup step where the user picks the Epic node the wallet uses.

deskSetupNodeLead: The wallet reads the chain and sends through an Epic node.

@deskSetupNodeLead.description: Lead under the title of the setup's node step.

@deskSetupLocalTitle.description: Title of the setup step about running the Epic node on this computer.

deskSetupLocalLead: What running the node here means, and which node to use.

@deskSetupLocalLead.description: Lead under the title of the setup's local node step.

@deskSetupEpicboxTitle.description: Title of the setup step about the Epicbox server, which holds payments while this wallet is closed.

@deskSetupReviewTitle.description: Title of the setup's last step: a summary of the choices.

deskSetupReviewLead: Change anything that is not right, then save.

@deskSetupReviewLead.description: Lead under the title of the setup's last step.

@deskSetupSideTitle.description: Title of the setup's side panel, above its step list. Short.

@deskSetupBackToWallet.description: Button in the setup's side panel when setup was opened again from Settings: leave it without changes.

@deskSetupSave.description: Main button on the setup's last step: save every choice.

@deskSetupLanguage.description: Label of the language picker on the setup's Preferences step, and the row in its summary. The language names in the list stay in their own language.

@deskSetupNodeServer.description: Label of the field where the user picks or types a public Epic node.

@deskSetupCheckingNodes.description: Shown in the node picker while the public node list is being checked.

@deskSetupPickNode.description: Shown in the node picker's field before a node is chosen.

@deskSetupRemoteNode.description: Choice card on the setup's node step: use a public node on the internet. Also the node type on the summary step.

deskSetupRemoteNodeText: Any public node. Ready at once.

@deskSetupRemoteNodeText.description: Text on the Remote node choice card.

deskSetupLocalNodeText: Runs on this computer: private, but needs disk space and a first sync.

@deskSetupLocalNodeText.description: Text on the Local node choice card of the setup's node step.

deskSetupEpicboxText: Epicbox delivers payments to the Epicbox address and holds them until the wallet is online.

@deskSetupEpicboxText.description: First paragraph of the setup's Epicbox step.

deskSetupEpicboxPrivacy: The Epicbox server sees this computer’s IP address.

@deskSetupEpicboxPrivacy.description: Second paragraph of the setup's Epicbox step: a privacy note.

@deskSetupEpicboxServer.description: Label of the Epicbox server field on the setup's Epicbox step.

@deskSetupChangePrefsSem.description: Screen reader label of the Change link next to the Preferences section on the setup's summary.

@deskSetupChangeNodeSem.description: Screen reader label of the Change link next to the Node section on the setup's summary.

@deskSetupChangeEpicboxSem.description: Screen reader label of the Change link next to the Epicbox section on the setup's summary.

@deskSetupChange.description: Link next to a section on the setup's summary: go back to that step.

@deskSetupType.description: Row label on the setup's summary: what kind of node. Narrow label column.

@deskSetupAddress.description: Row label on the setup's summary: the node's address. Narrow label column.

@deskSetupExistingNode.description: Node type on the setup's summary: an Epic node already running on this computer.

@deskSetupBundledNode.description: Node type on the setup's summary: the Epic node that comes with the app, run on this computer.

@deskSetupWhileSyncing.description: Row label on the setup's summary: which node the wallet uses while the local node syncs. Narrow label column.

@deskSetupWait.description: Value of the While syncing row when the wallet waits for the local node instead of using a public one. Lower case, one word.

@deskSetupDataFolder.description: Row label on the setup's summary: where the local node keeps the chain. Narrow label column.

deskSetupSaveStartsFallback: Save starts the node; {node} stands in until it is synced.

@deskSetupSaveStartsFallback.description: Note under the Node section of the setup's summary when the local node is chosen and a public node is used while it syncs.

deskSetupSaveStarts: Save starts the node. The first sync takes hours; the wallet opens meanwhile.

@deskSetupSaveStarts.description: Note under the Node section of the setup's summary when the local node is chosen and the wallet waits for it.

@deskSetupServer.description: Row label on the setup's summary: the Epicbox server. Narrow label column.

@deskSetupOff.description: Value of the Epicbox server row when no server is set: receiving through Epicbox is off.

@deskSetupSaveFailedTitle.description: Title of the red notice on the setup's last step after Save failed on a first run. The notice has a button to continue without saving (deskSetupSkipSave).

deskSetupSaveFailedText: {reason}. Save again, or skip to keep the settings saved so far.

@deskSetupSaveFailedText.description: Text of the red notice on the setup's last step after Save failed on a first run. {reason} is the error text, a short sentence without a final period (e.g. 'The wallet is locked'). 'Settings' is the app's Settings page.

deskSetupResumeLead: Setup was not finished last time. The wallet reads the chain and sends through an Epic node.

@deskSetupResumeLead.description: Lead under the title of the setup's node step when the app was closed before a first-run setup was saved and setup starts again. Second sentence is deskSetupNodeLead.
